policy: Display names only; no canonical symbol renaming. Proposed names do not count as identified. Evidence is source-based, not inferred from diff scores.

evidence.detail: Loads r0=1 and branches to TaskWaitForSignal; this is a signal identifier, not a tick duration.
Frame-processing sub_08001204 invokes sub_08000420(1); its VBlank wait is conditional on forcedBlank. This does not establish a fixed elapsed-time sleep.
Stores the supplied signal at task+0x14, saves context, sets state 4 and switches to scheduler stack. No decrement of a duration occurs.
Wake operation compares the supplied signal for exact equality with each task+0x14, clears it and sets state 1.
Waits for 0x11201100 and separately signals 0x514C8; demonstrates identifiers rather than tick counts.
Traverses gUnk_03001240; for each task whose +0x14 equals r0, clears +0x14 and sets +4 to ready state 1. It does not decrement sleep counters.
Traverses task list and returns one if a task has state 4 and a matching signal at +0x14; otherwise returns zero.
Scheduler insertion increments 03001244; global function names remain unchanged.
Loads global 03001244, initialized to one by 0023C, incremented on scheduling by 00274 and decremented on unlinking.
Scheduler insertion increments 03001244; global function names remain unchanged.
Traverses gUnk_03001240 task list, returning one when the requested task pointer is found.
Returns the current task pointer from gUnk_0300123C.
Updates the eight-byte feedback state03001318, then combines two state-selected bytes as a 16-bit result. Does not establish a standard RNG algorithm or SDK origin.
Updates the same eight-byte feedback state, then combines four state-selected bytes into a 32-bit result; shares transition structure with 0086C.
Enables DISPSTAT flag 8, clears forcedBlank in display shadow, writes DISPCNT and invokes 06BF8. No broader scene identity is inferred.
Clears DISPSTAT flags 0x18, sets forcedBlank in display shadow, writes DISPCNT and invokes 06C14.
Sets mode field in DISPCNT shadow and optionally writes hardware.
ORs first argument mask 0x1F00 and second mask 0xE000 into DISPCNT shadow, optionally writing hardware; does not clear other bits.
Sets frameSelect, hblankIntervalFree and objMapping1D fields from three boolean arguments, optionally writing DISPCNT.
Copies one 32-bit value from the supplied DispCnt structure into display-control shadow and optionally writes its low halfword to DISPCNT.
For background index 0..3, writes the supplied halfword to BG0CNT..BG3CNT; ignores null source and unsupported index.
Copies palette groups into RAM shadow03001F40 at palette-index*32. Queues a full 0x400-byte palette copy once while 03001310 is zero, then increments that flag.
Queues 0x400 bytes from palette shadow03001F40 to hardware palette RAM 05000000 through 01348.
Copies 0x24 halfwords from 03001250 to REG_ADDR_BG0HOFS, covering BG scroll/affine, window, mosaic and blend registers, not DISPCNT/BGCNT.
Reads selected BG0CNT..BG3CNT halfword into non-null output for indices 0..3.
Reads decompressed size from LZ77 header, rounds to 4 bytes; if destination is null, retries heap allocation while waiting for signal 1, then decompresses with LZ77UnCompWram and returns destination.
Enables IE HBlank flag and DISPSTAT HBlank interrupt flag through their shadows, with IME disable/enable and blank-interval waits.
Clears HBlank interrupt in IE shadow/register and clears DISPSTAT HBlank interrupt flag.
Enables IE VCount flag and DISPSTAT VCount interrupt flag through their shadows, with IME disable/enable and blank-interval waits.
Clears IE VCount interrupt and DISPSTAT VCount interrupt flag.
Waits until outside blank intervals, then clears both IME shadow and REG_IME.
Waits until outside blank intervals, then sets IME shadow and REG_IME to one.
Disables IME, ORs mask into IE shadow and REG_IE, then re-enables IME; does not preserve previous IME state.
Disables IME, clears mask from IE shadow and REG_IE, then re-enables IME; does not preserve previous IME state.
Disables IME, ORs mask into DISPSTAT shadow/register, then re-enables IME with blank-interval waits.
Clears mask from DISPSTAT shadow and writes REG_DISPSTAT directly.
Invokes callback 03000014 when nonzero, acknowledges REG_IF and BIOS interrupt-check mask 0x2 (HBlank).
INTR_FLAG_VBLANK/HBLANK/VCOUNT are masks1/2/4; these numbers are masks, not bit indices.
Replaces high byte of DISPSTAT shadow with the byte argument, writes hardware and returns previous high byte.
Invokes callback 03000010 when nonzero, acknowledges REG_IF and BIOS interrupt-check mask 0x4 (VCount).
INTR_FLAG_VBLANK/HBLANK/VCOUNT are masks1/2/4; these numbers are masks, not bit indices.
Replaces callback 03000010 and returns its previous value.
Clears callback 0300234C and frame-transfer-ready flag 03002350.
Optionally services m4a VSync/Main; when frame-transfer flag is set, invokes callback 0300234C, flushes register shadow/copy queue and clears flag. Acknowledges interrupt mask 0x1 (VBlank).
INTR_FLAG_VBLANK/HBLANK/VCOUNT are masks1/2/4; these numbers are masks, not bit indices.
Stores callback 0300234C, returning one for non-null or zero for null.
Invokes callback 03002354 and acknowledges REG_IF/BIOS check mask 0x800 (DMA3); there is no null callback guard.
Invokes callback 03002360 and acknowledges REG_IF/BIOS check mask 0x100 (DMA0); there is no null callback guard.
Replaces callback 03002354, used by DMA3 handler 01280, and returns previous value.
Replaces callback 03002360, used by DMA0 handler 012AC, and returns previous value.
Allocates 400 entries, clears src/dest/control, resets queue count and clears DMA3/DMA0 callback globals. Queue flush uses CPU copy BIOS calls, not DMA hardware.
Appends src/dest/byte-size while count<400; sets high control bit for sizes aligned to 32 bytes. Does not enqueue when full.
Consumes queued entries with CpuFastSet or CpuSet32 according to high control bit, then resets count. No DMA register programming occurs.
Resets queued memory-copy count to zero without executing copies.
Builds free-list/sentinel metadata over EWRAM with heap start EWRAM_START and recorded size 0x3FFFF.
Aligns allocation size, searches free blocks and splits the selected block.
Existing _free C definition is aliased to this canonical symbol. Bounds-checks pointer, clears block used bit and coalesces adjacent free blocks in heap free list.
Aligns size to 4 with minimum 16, traverses free list backward and splits an allocation from the selected block end, returning payload after 16-byte header.
Returns maximum free block span while walking heap blocks.
Accumulates free block spans while walking heap blocks.
Documented SDK initialization: reset registers, copy ISR, initialize buffers.
Documented SDK per-frame send24/receive4x24 processing and status flags.
Documented SDK 24-byte send-buffer copy and checksum.
Documented SDK checksum verification and 4x24 receive copy.
Documented SDK start flag.
Documented SDK disable SIO and timer3.
Per-frame session task passes send/receive blocks to MultiSioMain and stores its status.
Tag-based NOS/OK barrier handshake.
Documented accessor for own player id.
Documented per-player send block accessor.
Documented accessor for connected player count.
Documented per-player receive block accessor.
Copies local send block to receive block zero each frame and sets status 0x101.
Packs target masks/effect into shadow+0x40, EVA/EVB into+0x42 and brightness into+0x44; B50 copies these to BLDCNT/BLDALPHA/BLDY at 0x50/0x52/0x54.
Shadow base is copied to hardware starting at 0x04000010.
BLDCNT/BLDALPHA/BLDY offsets are 0x50/0x52/0x54.
Creates player entity and assigns per-slot send and receive block pointers.
Announces tagged message, sends eight-byte chunks, waits for peer acknowledgments.
Per-peer receiver acknowledges announce/chunks and dispatches message tag.
Matching C computes signed 32-bit product arg1 * arg0 then arithmetic right shift 8. This confirms an 8-fractional-bit multiply; SDK origin is not established.
Multiplies two signed 32-bit inputs in a 64-bit intermediate, then returns the low 32 bits of product shifted right 16; SDK origin is not established.
Promotes inputs to signed 64-bit, shifts numerator left 16, divides by denominator and returns signed 32-bit result; no explicit zero guard or SDK origin is established.
Matching C returns 0x10000/arg0: reciprocal in 8-fractional-bit representation. No explicit divide-by-zero guard; SDK origin is not established.
Resets phase, sets amplitude 0x10 and active flag, installs DMA3/VBlank callbacks, enables interrupt 0x800 and programs DMA3 from 03000264 to BG1HOFS 04000014 with control 0xE3400001.
REG_OFFSET_BG1HOFS is0x14 and DMA3 source register starts at 0xD4.
Clears active flag, disables DMA3 interrupt 0x800, waits for signal 1 then clears DMA3/VBlank callbacks. Callback 93498 observes inactive flag and disables DMA3.
sub_08093498 masks DMA3 control when active flag 03000268 is zero.
Advances phase 03000267 by 2; if active flag 03000268 is zero, masks DMA3 control to disable transfer/IRQ timing. Installed as VBlank callback by 933A0.
Task variant using global03000270 and waits through080003F0; precise screen role unknown.

Loop decrements the BG0 vertical scroll accumulator by 0xAA, increments BG1 vertical scroll by 0x80, writes their >>8 values to shadow+2/+6 and uses sine(phase)*5/256+10 as blend EVA; phase advances 3 and waits for signal 1.
Shadow offsets2/6 map to BG0VOFS/BG1VOFS through the register-shadow copy.
sub_0800903C packs the supplied coefficients into blend register shadow.
Initializes stack allocation 0x400 at global task 03000278, callback 948E0, stack top+0x3FC and priority 0x44, then schedules the task.
Callback948E0 directly scrolls BG0/BG1 and pulses blend coefficient.

Original ASM loop writes sine/cosine horizontal offsets at shadow+0/+4, vertical drift+0x100/+0x80 at+2/+6, complementary sine-driven blend coefficients 8+s and8-s, then waits for signal 1. C remains a nonmatching draft; identity comes from ASM.
Shadow offsets 0..6 are copied to BG0/BG1 horizontal/vertical offset registers.
Blend helper0903C packs the supplied coefficients.
Initializes stack allocation 0x400 at global task 0300027C, callback 94DEC, stack top+0x3FC and priority 0x44, then schedules it.
ASM callback implements BG0/BG1 sine scrolling and complementary alpha blend pulses.

Builds PA/PB/PC/PD from sine/cosine and reciprocal scales, then low/high reference coordinates. Writes shadow halfwords 8..15 only when all three effect checks return zero. The Y reference formula uses0x78 exactly as source; no centered-screen simplification is assumed.
sub_08000B50 copies 0x24 halfwords from gUnk_03001250 to REG_ADDR_BG0HOFS (0x04000010).
BG2PA/PB/PC/PD at 0x20..0x26 and BG2X/Y at 0x28/0x2C map shadow halfwords 8..15 to BG2 affine registers.
Sets display mode 2, enables BG2/OBJ, writes BG2CNT 0x7C82, calls sub_080921E4(5,0x1C), resets transform and sets position 0, offset 0xF8 and scale 0x200 before display resume.
sub_08000990 writes the display mode; sub_080009C0 enables display planes/window mask.
sub_08000AA8 case 2 writes BG2CNT.
Resets transform fields x/y/dx/dy/angle to zero and scaleX/scaleY to 0x100. The affine consumer 953F8 confirms field roles.
sub_080953F8 reads these scale, position, offset and angle fields to construct the BG2 affine register shadow.
Stores the two inputs in transform offsets 4/6, used as x/y by 953F8.
Affine consumer confirms the field roles rather than inferring them solely from setters.
Stores the two inputs in transform offsets 8/10, added to x/y by 953F8.
Affine consumer confirms the field roles rather than inferring them solely from setters.
Stores the two halfword inputs at offsets 0/2, consumed as reciprocal scales by 953F8.
